# AAU Studenterprojekter

> A comprehensive digital archive and search portal for Aalborg University student projects, master's theses, and academic research across multiple disciplines.

AAU Studenterprojekter serves as the official repository for student work at Aalborg University (AAU), providing access to completed master's theses and projects spanning education, urban planning, technology, social sciences, and humanities. The portal supports both Danish and English language content, facilitating discovery and sharing of academic research within the AAU community and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Master's thesis
- Student projects
- Thesis repository
- Academic portal
- Aalborg University
- Case study

- University database
- Project search
- Course design

- Educational technology
- Knowledge sharing
- Danish education

## Portal Access

- [AAU Studenterprojekter - Aalborg Universitet](https://projekter.aau.dk): Homepage of AAU student project portal for master's theses and projects
- [AAU Student Projects - Aalborg University](https://projekter.aau.dk/index_en.html): English version of AAU student project portal homepage

## Education & Learning Design

- [En modularisk template for IKT-baserte kurs](https://projekter.aau.dk/en-modularisk-template-for-ikt-baserte-kurs-61f71cb7.html): Master's thesis on modular ICT course template using Kolb's learning cycle
- [HCSøg](https://projekter.aau.dk/hcsog-5b9dfadb.html): Master's thesis on web-based learning platform for primary education
- [Internetbaseret Livssynslæring](https://projekter.aau.dk/internetbaseret-livssynslaering-c148fb24.html): Master's thesis on internet-based worldview education and religious communication

## Urban Planning & Infrastructure

- [Udbygning af ringvejen gennem Silkeborg](https://projekter.aau.dk/udbygning-af-ringvejen-gennem-silkeborg-97dad247.html): Master's project on traffic planning for Silkeborg ring road expansion
- [En bæredygtig strukturreform - med fokus på mulige konsekvenser for den fysiske planlægning](https://projekter.aau.dk/en-baeredygtig-strukturreform-med-fokus-pa-mulige-konsekvenser-for-den-fysiske-planlaegning-1c301026.html): Master's thesis on Danish municipal structural reform and urban planning

## Social Sciences & Organizational Studies

- [Fusionsledelse](https://projekter.aau.dk/fusionsledelse-655ce984.html): Master's thesis on merger leadership and human organizational change
- [Den lille socialreform og de socialpolitiske strategier fra 1956 til 1961](https://projekter.aau.dk/den-lille-socialreform-og-de-socialpolitiske-strategier-fra-1956-til-1961-3c08ba79.html): Master's thesis on Danish welfare state social reforms 1956-1961
- [Fysisk og virtuel mobilitet](https://projekter.aau.dk/fysisk-og-virtuel-mobilitet-eba7bd30.html): Student project on knowledge worker mobility and international travel patterns

## Cultural & Museum Studies

- [Hvordan innoverer vi museerne til de unge?](https://projekter.aau.dk/hvordan-innoverer-vi-museerne-til-de-unge-dc82b6d8.html): Master's thesis on museum innovation and young adult audience engagement
- [Arbejdermuseet](https://projekter.aau.dk/arbejdermuseet-b3990c85.html): Master's thesis analyzing The Workers' Museum Copenhagen exhibition communication

## Engineering & Technology

- [Laboratoriekalibrering af IMU400CC-100 og praktisk test af denne integrert med RTK-GPS](https://projekter.aau.dk/laboratoriekalibrering-af-imu400cc-100-og-praktisk-test-af-denne-integrert-med-rtk-gps-7de45070.html): Master's project on IMU calibration and RTK-GPS vehicle navigation testing
